# Table.AddFuzzyClusterColumn

```m
Table.AddFuzzyClusterColumn(table as table, columnName as text, newColumnName as text, optional options as nullable record) as table
```

Adds a new column with representative values obtained by fuzzy grouping values of the specified column in the table.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-addfuzzyclustercolumn)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `table` | `table` | no |
| `columnName` | `text` | no |
| `newColumnName` | `text` | no |
| `options` | `nullable record` | yes |
